messages:
zoe: Quick handoff — email creative + asset manifest for benchmark launch. Need: email header 800x200 (png + svg), three social tiles (1080x1080), one hero gif (1200x628, 2s) with static fallback, and a manifest.csv listing filenames, alt_text keys, CTAs, and UTM links. Deadline: Thu 10:00am.
kevin: Got it. Any A/B subject lines? I'll prep two variants and short preview text.
mia: Please ensure header includes the sparkline + small logo lockup. Also include a plain-text version for the email builder.
zoe: Draft subjects: A) "Reduce inference cost without trading latency" B) "See inference economics: webinar + benchmark". Preheader should be <=90 chars.
legal-ops: Quick flag: avoid definitive percentage claims in email body. Prefer qualifiers like "up to" or "median" and add footnote: "based on internal benchmark vs baseline." We'll review copy once posted.
designbot: Export queued id=G321 frames=[email-header,social-1,social-2,social-3,hero-gif,manifest-template,brand-checklist] variants=[default,a11y-high-contrast] outputs=[png:800x200,svg,png:1080x1080,gif:1200x628,csv,pdf]. ETA ~9m.
ops: When exports are ready I can push images to CDN and update Iterable. Include manifest.csv with columns: filename, alt_text_key, language, variant, cta, utm.
kevin: I'll add subject + preview into the copy doc and mark any numeric strings for legal review. Mia can you confirm translations for DE next week?
mia: Yep — I'll handle DE and flag numeric strings. Also: hero gif needs a static PNG fallback and aria-label for the MP4 on the web.
legal-ops: Once copy + manifest arrive we'll do a rapid pass. Keep all numeric claims consistent across localized variants.
zoe: Add brand-checklist.pdf (logo clearspace, hex list, type styles) to exports so ops can validate uploads. Closing loop unless issues.
